attribution.notice: Parent corrections of the ingredient tree: Mixtura's own judgement of drink categories, written for Drink Builder; the Bar Assistant data stays as published and is overridden only here.

corrections.note: Cocchi Americano is an aromatised wine flavoured with cinchona and gentian, a quinquina like Lillet, which sits directly under fortified wine; it is not a dry vermouth, so a recipe that names dry vermouth must not count it.

evidence.source: Own knowledge of the category; no source read (the host that was meant to be read, en.wikipedia.org, is outside the session's network). To verify: producer page or a reference on aromatised wines.

corrections.note: Tequila and mezcal are separate agave spirits with separate designations of origin; a recipe that names mezcal asks for its character and tequila does not stand in for it. Tequila keeps its four ageing children.

evidence.source: Own knowledge of the two designations; no source read (host blocked). To verify: the Mexican standards NOM-006-SCFI (tequila) and NOM-070-SCFI (mezcal).
